statusDefinitions.implemented: Behavior exists and has an automated test for the stated scope.
statusDefinitions.partial: Behavior exists for a bounded subset; the limitation and evidence are listed.
statusDefinitions.planned: Not advertised. Follow-up work is recorded below.
statusDefinitions.unavailable: The active 0.1.1 toolchain explicitly does not provide this behavior.

advertisingRule: A capability is advertised only when advertised is true and evidence is non-empty. Partial capabilities must display their scope and limitation in Vitte: Show Capabilities.

editorFeatures.label: Completion
editorFeatures.description: Contextual completions for lexical bindings, keywords, declared types, form fields, pick variants, callable declarations and values, attributes, filesystem module/import paths, explicitly imported exports, and trait methods with a visible implementation or generic trait bound.
editorFeatures.limitation: The active compiler has no editor semantic-query API. Results are parsed from a bounded source subset, so overload resolution and inferred receiver types are unavailable; direct inherent impl methods and type-qualified associated functions are not advertised because the active frontend does not validate them. Trait method suggestions require a visible trait plus a source-detected implementation or bound. Named procedure-call arguments are not in the active grammar. Missing module roots and unresolved typed receivers show a non-inserting status item. Files over 512 KiB use a lightweight keyword/builtin fallback; disk enumeration and module reads are bounded.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: completion is suppressed inside comments and strings and offers keywords
test/language.test.cjs: completion follows local types, fields, variants, generic trait bounds, shadowing and nested lexical scopes
test/language.test.cjs: completion resolves real module paths, public exports, aliases and imported trait members
test/language.test.cjs: unsupported inherent methods and trait declarations are not advertised as callable members
test/language.test.cjs: bundled server serves completion over stdio LSP
Vitte 0.1.1 parse --stop-after-parser accepted the tested forms, pick variants, generic procedure and constructor fixture

editorFeatures.label: Signature help
editorFeatures.description: Shows parameter names, types and available documentation for local and imported procedures, callable values, supported trait methods, and named form fields; tracks nested calls and incomplete argument lists.
editorFeatures.limitation: The active compiler has no editor semantic-query API. Imported and overloaded signatures are source-derived; named procedure-call arguments are unavailable in the active grammar, while named form fields are supported.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: signature help counts arguments after strings containing surrogate pairs
test/language.test.cjs: signature help tracks nested incomplete calls, generics, aliases and parameter docs
test/language.test.cjs: form initializer signature help follows named fields and documentation
grammar/vitte.ebnf: procedure calls accept positional expression lists; form initializers accept named fields

editorFeatures.label: Hover
editorFeatures.description: Shows source signatures, annotations, literal-inferred types, docs, module/import paths, fields, variants, parameters and compiler builtin signatures where the source index can identify them.
editorFeatures.limitation: The active compiler exposes no editor semantic-query API. Inference is limited to explicit annotations and simple literals/constructors; unknown or intrinsic-only targets display an explicit unavailable explanation.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: source hover resolves declarations, signatures, types, docs, fields, variants and simple inference

editorFeatures.label: Workspace symbols
editorFeatures.description: Searches declarations in open documents and a bounded scan of Vitte source files under workspace, configured project and module roots; groups nested results by their container.
editorFeatures.limitation: This is a source index, not a compiler symbol table. It scans at most 256 files and 16 MiB of source per request and may omit results in larger workspaces.

editorFeatures.label: Rename symbol
editorFeatures.provider: Vitte language server source indexer with versioned workspace edits
editorFeatures.description: Prepares and renames tested local declarations, scoped references, explicit imports and aliases. VS Code file moves also update module declarations and imports when a unique project-root mapping is proven.
editorFeatures.limitation: The active compiler exposes no symbol graph. Public rename scans are bounded to 1024 files, 64 MiB and two seconds; incomplete or changed scans, collisions, unresolved tokens and ambiguous file mappings are refused. The extension previews affected files and rechecks unsaved buffers before applying.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: rename resolves symbol identity, preserves import aliases and ignores comments, strings and shadowed bindings
